en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I like boys who are really▼handsome and kind and funny and▼smart.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;I'd always be wondering, "Why▼did he pick me? Does he REALLY▼like me?" You know what I mean?

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;It's not like I'm not interested▼in romance...

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'178'10'1;$022'327'361;What's the best way to confess▼you're in love with someone?▼Face-to-face? In a letter?

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;At least, that's what someone▼said on a TV show.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I love getting presents from▼Santa at Christmas time.

en: But he's always giving stuff to▼me, and I've never given▼anything in return.
vi: Nhưng ông cứ cho tớ quà mãi, tớ▼chưa đáp lại lần nào.

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;So this year I'm going to leave▼a present for Santa in my▼stocking!
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Nên năm nay tớ sẽ để quà cho ông▼trong chiếc tất Noel!

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Whether shopping for books or▼clothes or whatever, I'm always▼the same...
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Dù mua sách, quần áo hay thứ gì,▼tớ đều thế cả...

en: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I want the nicest and cleanest▼item they have in the shop.

en: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;So I never take whatever is at▼the very front of the shelf or▼on the top of a pile.
vi: $024'327'0;$023'327'1'4'0;Nên tớ không lấy món ở đầu kệ▼hay trên cùng chồng đồ.

en: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;The trouble is, the ones at the▼back are usually the wrong size,▼or all covered in dust.
vi: $024'327'3;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'304;Nhưng đồ phía trong thường sai▼cỡ, hoặc bám đầy bụi.

en: $024'327'4;$023'327'171'10'1;$022'327'383;I guess it serves me right for▼trying to be so clever.
$024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;I love it when it starts to get▼nice and warm in the spring.
vi: $024'327'1;$023'327'173'6'2;$022'327'341;Tớ thích nhất lúc xuân về, trời▼bắt đầu ấm áp.
